Name: Emily's flat - C/ Alonso Cano 4
Cost Range: Taxi grande ~18-22 EUR, or two ordinary taxis ~13-16 EUR each
Tips: 08:45 THE BAG MOVE - C. de Alejandro Dumas 30 to here, ~20 min north through the centre. 4 PEOPLE + 2 x 23 KG + DAYPACKS DOES NOT FIT ONE STANDARD MADRID TAXI: book a taxi grande (7-seat monovolumen) from Radio-Taxi +34 91 547 82 00, or take two ordinary taxis. CHECK WHETHER THERE IS A LIFT to the 2nd floor before anyone shoulders 23 kg. 09:10 first look, 50 minutes: bags in, find the fuse box, boiler, water shut-off, rubbish room, nearest 24h pharmacy. PHOTOGRAPH THE METER READINGS AND ANY DAMAGE TODAY - deposit disputes in December start here. HARD PIN: both checked bags inside 2ºA before the day ends. CONFIRM THIS WEEK IN WRITING THAT SHE HAS KEYS ON SEP 4.

Name: Plaza de Olavide
Tips: 2 min from her door, and the actual answer to 'what's my neighbourhood like' - circular plaza, four terraces, a playground, zero tourists. Walk her through it in the morning, and it is the no-booking dinner fallback tonight (20-30 EUR/pp).

Name: Nuevos Ministerios station
Tips: 10:05 - WALK HER COMMUTE ON FOOT, ~15-18 min south-east across Chamberí. Do it once, together: it is the walk she will make most mornings until December. Hot-day alternative: Metro Iglesia L1 to Cuatro Caminos, L6 to here, ~15 min with two changes; or bus 3 / 149 straight down. POINT OUT WHERE THE CERCANÍAS ENTRANCE IS inside the interchange - it is not obvious and it is not the Metro entrance.

Name: Cantoblanco Universidad (UAM)
Tips: 10:30 Cercanías C-4, ~15 min. Buy her ticket, then LET HER BUY THE RETURN HERSELF. 10:45 on campus, walk in 10 min, she is in at 11:00. HARD PIN. GET THE REAL END TIME FROM HER THE NIGHT BEFORE - the meetup may end at 16:00 or as early as 12:00, and the two versions of this afternoon are different days. FORK B (out at 12:00): do not go anywhere in the gap, wait at the UAM Plaza Mayor cafeterías and take ALL FOUR to El Pardo 12:30-16:30 - the better day if it is offered.

Name: Palacio Real de El Pardo
Address: Calle Manuel Alonso, 28048 El Pardo, Madrid
Tips: 11:35-15:20 (FORK A) - taxi from campus ~20 min west across the Monte de El Pardo, ~22-28 EUR. Order one in Bolt/Free Now before leaving her building; the campus rank is unreliable. Carlos I's hunting lodge rebuilt into a palace - the finest Bayeu and Goya TAPESTRY collection hanging anywhere, room after room. Franco lived here 1940-1975; it is now the official residence for visiting heads of state. Apr-Sep Tue-Sun ~10:00-19:00, CLOSED MON. VERIFY AT tickets.patrimonionacional.es THE DAY BEFORE - it shuts at no notice for state visits.

Name: Convento del Cristo de El Pardo
Address: Calle del Cristo, 28048 El Pardo, Madrid
Tips: Capuchin monastery hiding Gregorio Fernández's Cristo yacente (1605) - the most unsettlingly lifelike sculpture in Spanish baroque, and a family-taste bullseye given the church list on this trip. ~10:00-13:00 + 16:00-19:00, verify.

Name: Casita del Príncipe
Tips: Villanueva's neoclassical garden pavilion for the future Carlos IV. Limited opening - verify, treat as a bonus.

Name: Monte de El Pardo
Tips: The best-preserved Mediterranean holm-oak forest in Europe, protected as a royal hunting ground since the 1400s - which is exactly why it survived. Deer graze in sight of the road. The village itself (4,000 people, whitewashed streets, the parade ground, holm oaks down to the Manzanares) is 30 easy minutes.

Name: Casa Julián de El Pardo
Tips: 13:30 - the tortilla people drive out from Madrid for: thick, barely set, and the reason half the tables are full of madrileños on a Friday.

Name: La Marquesita
Tips: 13:30 option - village asador, game, roast meats, a terrace under the trees.

Name: Terraza Jardín Felipe
Tips: 13:30 option - shaded garden terraces, easy family menus. 15:20 taxi back to Cantoblanco, ~22-28 EUR, be at her building by 15:55.

Name: Mercado de Vallehermoso
Tips: 18:45, 8 min from her door - Chamberí's working market turned food hall, where she will actually shop. FRIDAY EVENING HOURS VARY, verify. 17:00-18:30 first: the unglamorous hour that matters more than any sight - unpack the checked bags, Mercadona/Carrefour Express for the first shop, a farmacia, sheets and a towel if the flat came bare.

Name: Andén 0 - Estación de Chamberí
Tips: 18:45, 12 min, 20 minutes inside - the 1919 Metro station SEALED SHUT IN 1966 and left underground for 40 years, reopened as a museum with its original tiled advertisements intact. Trains still rush past the platform without stopping. Free and strange. FRIDAY HOURS ROUGHLY 11:00-19:00 - verify at metromadrid.es and GO AT 18:45, NOT LATER. If it is shut, it is a gift for her own weekend. NOTE: Museo Sorolla is closed for major renovation - do not build the evening on it.

Name: Lakasa
Address: Plaza del Descubridor Diego de Ordás 1, 28003 Madrid
Tips: 20:45 FAREWELL DINNER, THE PICK - 12 min straight up Alonso Cano. César Martín's Chamberí flagship: sharing plates, the famous pastela of fried cheese, mushroom dishes people plan trips around, a wine list with actual depth. Warm rather than formal, which is what a last night wants. BOOK THIS WEEK - Chamberí's good tables go 1-2 weeks out and this is a Friday.

Name: Bacira
Tips: 20:45 farewell option, 10 min - Mediterranean-Japanese-Peruvian in a bright corner house. Half portions encouraged, so the table eats twelve things instead of four. The most fun option and the teens' pick.

Name: Arima Basque Gastronomy
Tips: 20:45 farewell option, 12 min - pintxos logic scaled up to proper plates, txuleta, the burnt cheesecake. On Ponzano, so the street is alive around it.

Name: Fismuler
Tips: 20:45 farewell option, 15 min - spare Nordic-ish room, precise Spanish cooking, and the cheesecake that started the national obsession.

Name: Las Tortillas de Gabino
Tips: 20:45 farewell option, 10 min - Chamberí institution, the tortilla flight plus serious market cooking. Comes in UNDER budget and never disappoints; the safe pick if everyone is wrecked. +34 91 319 75 05.

Name: Sacha
Address: Calle de Juan Hurtado de Mendoza 11, 28036 Madrid
Tips: THE STRETCH, ~20 min - the cult Madrid bistro chefs eat at, famously hard to get into. Worth one phone call; do not build the night on it. ORDER THE TABLE'S LAST TOAST IN SPANISH AND LET EMILY DO IT. She lives here now. 22:45 taxi home to Arganzuela ~14-16 EUR - say goodbye at her door, not at 06:30 tomorrow. BEFORE BED, NON-NEGOTIABLE: pre-book the 06:45 airport taxi and do AA 95 online check-in.
